dialects.description: Published Charter v0.1 executable conformance manifest.
Experimental shared schemas and explicitly registered fixtures.
Non-claimable conceptual coverage with explicit promotion criteria.

profiles.implementationStatus: Shared terminology is used by Charter v0.1; no standalone Core manifest exists.
knownDeviations: Publication and canonical JSON rules remain incomplete.
promotionCriteria: Publish a standalone manifest covering paths, versions, diagnostics, and trust rules.
profiles.entryPoint: Core terminology, then Charter v0.1 for executable behavior.

profiles.implementationStatus: The shared evidence schema is executable; discovery and negotiation are requirements only.
knownDeviations: No discovery manifest or cross-implementation evidence corpus exists.
promotionCriteria: Add a manifest with neutral observation, authority, replay, CAS, and privacy cases.
profiles.entryPoint: Read after Core when implementing shared evidence.

profiles.implementationStatus: Reference parser, validator, editor, runtime compiler, and portable cases are implemented.
profiles.entryPoint: Start here for executable artifact conformance.

profiles.implementationStatus: Roster and routing are implemented in multiple shapes but have no portable manifest.
knownDeviations: Routing fallback and ambiguity policies are not represented uniformly.
promotionCriteria: Add separate roster and routing cases, joins, diagnostics, stale-write, and resolution evidence.
profiles.entryPoint: Read roster requirements before routing requirements.

profiles.implementationStatus: Configuration, casting registry, and provenance exist but are not one portable profile.
knownDeviations: Legacy registry shapes and runtime-only configuration keys remain accepted.
promotionCriteria: Add independent configuration, casting, and provenance manifests with migration and CAS cases.
profiles.entryPoint: Read configuration, casting identity, then provenance sections independently.

profiles.implementationStatus: The evidence schema and representative rejection fixture are executable; no transition manifest exists.
knownDeviations: Repository governance previously permitted immediate owner self-revision.
promotionCriteria: Add a transition manifest covering approval, lockout, replay, CAS, blockers, escalation, and deadlock.
profiles.entryPoint: Use the evidence contract for records; treat transition prose as draft requirements.

profiles.implementationStatus: Selection and fallback exist in the reference runtime only.
knownDeviations: Provider model names and fallback chains are implementation policy.
promotionCriteria: Add preference-resolution cases with policy, authorization, availability, and loss reporting.
profiles.entryPoint: Use for portable intent design, not a current conformance claim.

profiles.implementationStatus: The state vocabulary is a provider-neutral design; no executable transition corpus exists.
knownDeviations: Current providers do not expose one shared revision or recovery model.
promotionCriteria: Add complete positive and negative transition traces against GitHub and one non-GitHub provider.

profiles.implementationStatus: GitHub adapters exist, but deterministic sanitized provider transcripts do not.
knownDeviations: API-version evidence, precedence, CAS, partial-failure, and drift records are not emitted uniformly.
promotionCriteria: Add versioned transcripts for simultaneous conditions, stale writes, labels, rate limits, partial failure, and drift.
profiles.entryPoint: Read after the neutral work lifecycle.

profiles.implementationStatus: Planning artifacts are observable in gh-aw, but no portable manifest is published.
knownDeviations: Provider safe-output envelopes and fast-path behavior are implementation-specific.
promotionCriteria: Add granular and fast-path cases with acceptance revision, partial activation, replay, and dependency failures.
profiles.entryPoint: Use for planning ontology coverage only.

profiles.implementationStatus: Builders preserve trigger strings and schedules; cooldown execution is not proven.
knownDeviations: Observed triggers include manual, schedule, and event names such as pr-merged; legacy auto is ambiguous.
promotionCriteria: Add normalized trigger, injected-clock cooldown, duplicate-claim, and output-validation fixtures.
profiles.entryPoint: Treat trigger normalization and cooldown as promotion requirements.

profiles.implementationStatus: Session and handoff implementations are provider-specific.
knownDeviations: Transport ordering, expiry, and recovery evidence are not portable.
promotionCriteria: Add message-envelope and transition cases for duplicate, ordering, cancellation, loss, and recovery.
profiles.entryPoint: Use for envelope design, not transport conformance.

profiles.implementationStatus: Local and GitHub schedulers exist without a portable execution manifest.
knownDeviations: Time-zone, generated-provider, and retry evidence differ by provider.
promotionCriteria: Add trigger, clock, claim-race, retry, timeout, generation-drift, and redaction fixtures.

profiles.implementationStatus: Multiple backends and memory providers exist with different authority and recovery semantics.
knownDeviations: No backend-neutral CAS, recovery, migration, privacy, or deletion corpus exists.
promotionCriteria: Meet the independently listed state-authority and memory-classification promotion gates.
profiles.entryPoint: Read state authority separately from memory classification.
